description: Aires de livraison is a dataset listed in Open Data Hauts-de-Seine, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Localisation et caractéristiques des aires de livraison sur le département des Hauts-de-Seine Ce jeu de données présente la localisation et les caractéristiques des aires de livraison situées sur les routes départementales situées dans le département des Hauts-de-Seine selon le recensement effectué en 2026. Coverage: Hauts-de-Seine. The portal files it under Transport / Mobilité. Its keywords are aires, livraisons, aires de livraison, transports. The portal shows 1,383 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-hauts-de-seine-fr-portal.
